entities.title: Random generators
entities.summary: The main generator every rule draws from, and the cosmetic generator the picture draws from.
entities.purpose: Declares the two deterministic generators (RULES C.2.1 and deliberate difference 3): MainGenerator, whose draws are part of the rules and their order, and CosmeticGenerator, for the picture only.
boundaries: A capability: it uses no feature or use case (tests/layers.rs).
Nothing in the sim may use any other source of randomness.
